qualification.details: Sericulture Assistant : Three years full time degree in Sericulture OR Four years full time degree in Sericulture OR Three years full time degree + PG Diploma in Sericulture OR Three years full time degree in Biological Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Life science) + PG diploma in Sericulture OR Four years full time bachelor degree in Agriculture Sciences OR Three years full time bachelor degree in Biological Sciences + one year experience in Sericultural project work. Work experience in the field of silkworm rearing & grainage (Pre-Cocoon Sector) is a desirable qualification.

salary_details.details: Sericulture Assistant : Rs. 21,000/- + HRA per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSB ISBR Sericulture Assistant Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSB ISBR to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSB Institute for Seri-Biotechnological Research (CSB ISBR), Central Silk Board, for filling up project-based positions in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in CSB ISBR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Sericulture Assistant (SA) under the research field, aimed at hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis for project work.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Sericulture Assistant (SA) post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary provided for the Sericulture Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Sericulture Assistant (SA) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 21,000/- plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three or four-year full-time degree in Sericulture, Biological Sciences, or Agriculture Sciences, along with required PG diploma or relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit to apply for CSB ISBR Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 35 years as of the prescribed cut-off date mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 7 October 2026 and concludes on 6 November 2026, which is the last date to submit applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for CSB ISBR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the designated portal provided by the Central Silk Board hiring platform.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Sericulture Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial screening of applications received online, followed by a Personal Interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://www.isbr.res.in/ and check the important links section of this article for direct access.
